step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram and transcript illustrate Samsung Cloud's global multi-region networking infrastructure using AWS Transit Gateway. VPCs across four regions (KR, US, EU, SG) connect locally to regional Transit Gateways, which are interconnected via inter-region TGW peering to create a global private network backbone. Additionally, the architecture incorporates hybrid connectivity options, including Direct Connect Gateway for connecting on-premises data centers and Site-to-Site VPN for third-party/external service integrations.
